title: Conformational Analyses of the AHD1-UBAN Region of TNIP1 Highlight Key Amino Acids for Interaction with Ubiquitin.
authors: Samulevich, Michael L; Carman, Liam E; Shamilov, Rambon; Aneskievich, Brian J
one_liner_zh: 该文研究TNIP1蛋白AHD1-UBAN区域构象柔性及其对泛素识别的调控，属于蛋白-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Tumor necrosis factor a (TNFa)-induced protein 3 (TNFAIP3)-interacting protein 1 (TNIP1) is genetically and functionally linked to limiting auto-immune and inflammatory responses. We have shown that TNIP1 (alias A20-binding inhibitor of NF-kappaB 1, ABIN1), functioning as a hub location to coordinate other proteins in repressing inflammatory signaling, aligns with biophysical traits indicative of its being an intrinsically disordered protein (IDP). IDPs move through a repertoire of three-dimensional structures rather than being in one set conformation. Here we employed bioinformatic analysis and biophysical interventions via amino acid mutations to assess and alter, respectively, conformational flexibility along a crucial region of TNIP1, encompassing the ABIN homology domain 1 and ubiquitin-binding domain in ABIN proteins and NEMO (AHD1-UBAN), by purposeful replacement of key residues. In vitro secondary structure measurements were mostly in line with, but not necessarily to the same degree as, expected results from in silico assessments. Notably, changes in single amino acids outside of the ubiquitin-binding region for gain-of-order effects had consequences along the length of the AHD1-UBAN propagating to that region. This is evidenced by differences in recognition of the partner protein polyubiquitin >/= 28 residues away, depending on the mutation site, from the previously identified key binding site. These findings serve to demonstrate the role of conformational flexibility in protein partner recognition by TNIP1, thus identifying key amino acids likely to impact the molecular dynamics involved in TNIP1 repression of inflammatory signaling at large.
abstract_zh: 肿瘤坏死因子a（TNFa）诱导蛋白3（TNFAIP3）相互作用蛋白1（TNIP1）在遗传和功能上与限制自身免疫及炎症反应相关。我们已表明，TNIP1（别名A20结合NF-kappaB抑制剂1，ABIN1）作为协调其他蛋白以抑制炎症信号传导的枢纽位置，其特性与内在无序蛋白（intrinsically disordered protein, IDP）的生物物理特征相符。IDP通过一系列三维结构移动，而非处于单一固定构象。在此，我们采用生物信息学分析和通过氨基酸突变的生物物理干预，分别评估和改变TNIP1关键区域（涵盖ABIN蛋白中的ABIN同源结构域1和泛素结合域及NEMO（AHD1-UBAN））的构象灵活性，通过有意替换关键残基实现。体外二级结构测量结果大多与计算机模拟评估的预期结果一致，但程度未必完全相同。值得注意的是，在泛素结合区域之外的单氨基酸改变，为获得有序效应，其影响沿AHD1-UBAN全长传播至该区域。这通过伴侣蛋白多聚泛素（polyubiquitin）识别差异得以证实，该识别位点距离先前确定的关键结合位点≥28个残基，具体取决于突变位点。这些发现证明了构象灵活性在TNIP1蛋白伴侣识别中的作用，从而识别出可能影响TNIP1整体抑制炎症信号传导所涉及分子动力学的关键氨基酸。
